title: Expectation under a mapped distribution
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\Lambda$ be finite sets, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $g:\Omega\to\Lambda$, and let $f:\Lambda\to\mathbb{R}$. The expectation of $f$ under the distribution obtained by mapping $p$ through $g$ equals the expectation under $p$ of the composite function $f\circ g$.
